criterionText: Restart and resume are proven mid-objective without duplicating a decision, a Claude run, a commit or a cost entry
scenario: A real prior attempt (session PROJECTOS-AUTONOMOUS-GATEKEEPER-LOOP1A-6b2bd107f83d-79532a25, invocation 79532a2597d93c4b, 2026-08-23T23:19Z) ran to a genuine STOPPED-for-owner outcome, spanning a real multi-day/session gap before being resumed — the most faithful restart scenario available, more faithful than an artificial SIGKILL: the process genuinely ended, the objective was genuinely left mid-flight, and `projectos run --execute --resume --session <id>` was used exactly as an operator would after any interruption.

noDuplicateClaudeRun.evidence: session.json state field: 'started' on the original attempt, 'rejoined' on the resume — never 'started' twice. Same providerRef (36a29cfa-aa68-497e-bf43-5c3747743edb) before and after, unchanged, proving the SAME underlying Claude Code CLI conversation was continued via resolution.adapter.rejoin(), not a fresh adapter.start() spawning a new conversation.

noDuplicateDecision.evidence: The original request GKREQ-3b29e08264e3934557a45f31 (answered 2026-08-23) appears exactly once in .projectops/gatekeeper-ledger.json after the resume — grep count 1. The resume recomputed the proposal against the CURRENT head (83dc703b2bec..., several commits later than the original 6b2bd107f83d...), producing a materially different evidence digest and therefore a legitimately NEW deterministic request id (GKREQ-fc01fb01fe1e9036959fc2dc) for a genuinely different question, not a replay of the old one.

noDuplicateCostEntry.evidence: Ledger contains one entry per distinct requestId; the original 43444-micro-USD-adjacent charge from the resumed attempt is for the new (different-subject-commit) question only. No entry appears twice for the same requestId.

noDuplicateCommit.evidence: This worker (claude-local) is tool-scoped to .projectops/execution/*.findings.json and *.effects.json only (project-config.json execution.workers[0].args allowlist) — it makes no commits at all, on either the original attempt or the resume. Nothing to duplicate; the property holds trivially and by construction for this worker class.

sideNote: The resumed run's live gatekeeper review re-surfaced REVIEW-SEC-001 (= C11-W2-F5), the SAME finding investigated and confirmed STALE in the immediately preceding evidence record (review-sec-001-stale-verification.json, commit 83dc703). It resurfaces because the worker reads .projectops/execution/c11-w2-f1-correction.json fresh each attempt, and that historical evidence file's own prose still describes the pre-fix state (accurately, as history) without a forward pointer to the fix. This is not a new finding and not a regression — the current source was directly verified moments earlier with 6/6 adversarial tests passing. No source or evidence-file text modified, per the owner's Outcome-B ruling (do not modify source, continue immediately).
